q1.explanationZh: 文章从头到尾都在讲让人难受的声音，比如喝汤的声音、嚼东西的声音，所以“令人不适的交响乐”指各种难听的声音。

evidence.quote: This symphony of eating plays everywhere.

q2.explanationZh: 第二段说科学家认为大约18%的人有这种问题，但作者不同意，觉得我们每个人偶尔都有一点，所以分歧在人数上。

evidence.quote: Scientists say this condition affects about 18 per cent of the population, but I beg to differ.

q3.explanationZh: 作者说喝汤应该把勺子举起来，轻轻把汤送进嘴里。图B里的人正是这样做的。

evidence.quote: I think we should lift the spoon and gently send the liquid into our mouths.

q4.explanationZh: 第四段说街上有些人像动物园里的狮子，吃东西像是怕食物跑掉一样。

evidence.quote: On the street, some people are like lions in a zoo.

q5.explanationZh: 作者说自己以前整夜磨牙，还爱嚼冰块，这让妻子想逃跑。所以让别人烦的是①和③。

evidence.quote: I used to grind my teeth all night.
I enjoy chewing on the leftover cubes with the few good teeth I do have.

q6.explanationZh: 作者说自己牙齿剩得不多，只有几颗好牙，所以健康的牙很少。

evidence.quote: I don’t have many teeth left
with the few good teeth I do have
